data.rationale: The proposal covers the same core path (city, Special Events, event, ticket dropdown, Book Now), but it blends in a restaurant-search branch, names no date parameter, never includes the final "Reserve Now" click (it stops at the summary panel), and lists specific event names as parameters, so an automation built from it would be partly ambiguous.
